pages.text: Your air lasts much longer underwater, and you mine at full speed underwater. Found in shipwreck treasure, ocean ruins, and rare trail ruins.
Fire lasts $(l)half as long$() on you, and you take $(l)30% less fire damage$(). Helps against the Living Ember curse.
At light level 7 or lower, gain $(l)+10% movement speed$() and $(l)+15% attack damage$().
$(l)+1 max heart$(). When a hit leaves you below half health, gain Regeneration I for 4s. Cooldown: $(l)20s$().
